content.text:
Write a natural short email exchange. Subject: Dinner. Participants: Me, Ben; Me is the owner's speaker label, not a spoken name. Date: 2026-10-12, local time 20:00–21:15.
Scenario: Ben follows up by email after arranging dinner in their DM, passing along the restaurant address. This starts the email thread naturally.

The conversation must naturally and unambiguously establish each of these facts (they are authoring constraints, not lines to copy):
1. Ben and the user confirm the same Thursday dinner at 7 pm at Juniper Cafe. It is the existing outing from their DM, not another booking.
Use 2–6 short emails. The subject is header metadata; do not put a Subject: prefix inside an email body. Return only JSON with dialogue (an array of {"sender": "Name", "body": "email text"}) and writer_note (a short string). Bodies may contain paragraphs and quoted replies using escaped newlines.

output.encrypted_content: <encrypted reasoning retained in private run artifact>

summary.text: Drafting a short 2-6 email thread to confirm the Thursday 7 pm dinner at Juniper Cafe from the prior DM.
Structuring a 2-6 message JSON with sender labels and escaped newlines for quoted replies.
